title: Mette Norgaard (Leading with Aliveness) — 'The counterforce to financial gravity is not defiance. It is vitality. Flourishing. Aliveness.'
summary: Mette Norgaard — leadership author (Leading with Aliveness, The Ultimate Coach) — publishes a distinctive reaction to Incorruptible: reframing the response to financial gravity not as defiance but as vitality.
